name: Bloom of the Heavens

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see Nord'el as a precious remnant of Kalimdor's sacred heritage. It is also a sign of Elune's care as the kaldorei adapt to the loss of their immortality.
As an Alliance traveler, you can cross from Menethil Harbor in the Eastern Kingdoms to Auberdine and Darnassus in northern Kalimdor.
As an herbalist, you can appreciate Nord'el's recovery. This sacred flower was thought lost for ages and needs cultivation in Darnassus.

faq.answer: Nord'el is a sacred flower the night elves long thought lost. Its survival after many years is a treasured sign of Elune's favor and nature's resilience.

aliases: who gives bloom of the heavens
faq.answer: Sylessa in the Wetlands gives you Nord'el to carry. She recovered the sacred bloom despite an ambush and pursuit by hostile murlocs, but the ordeal left her too exhausted to make the journey herself.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Bloom of the Heavens?

faq.answer: Carry Nord'el across the sea to Elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine, on the coast of Darkshore. A boat sails directly from Menethil Harbor to Auberdine.
faq.q: Where does Nord'el need to be delivered?

aliases: why is nord'el important to night elves
faq.answer: Elder Thundris Windweaver sees Nord'el's survival as a beacon of hope. The sacred flower recalls Elune's grace and the kaldorei's endurance after they sacrificed their immortality during the Third War.
faq.q: Why is Nord'el so significant to the night elves?

faq.answer: After Nord'el reaches Auberdine, Thundris Windweaver arranges to have it carried inland to Darnassus. There, night elf botanists and priests can nurture and cultivate it.
faq.q: What will happen to the flower after reaching Auberdine?

aliases: how to get to auberdine from wetlands
faq.answer: Take the boat from Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands across the Great Sea to Auberdine in Darkshore.
faq.q: How do you travel from Menethil Harbor to Auberdine?

sections.body: In the Wetlands, Sylessa recovers Nord'el, the legendary flower, despite an attack by local murlocs. Worn out by her escape, she entrusts the plant to you for its voyage across the Great Sea to Auberdine. From Menethil Harbor, a boat sails directly to Darkshore, linking the Eastern Kingdoms with northern Kalimdor.
sections.title: A Perilous Retrieval

sections.body: When Nord'el reaches Auberdine, Elder Thundris Windweaver is astonished. He believed the sacred bloom had vanished forever. Night elves still bear the cost of surrendering their immortality after the Battle of Mount Hyjal, and Nord'el's survival feels like a blessing from Elune. Thundris prepares to send the delicate plant to Darnassus, where it can be cultivated and preserved for future generations.
sections.title: A Sign of Elune's Grace

summary: Across the Great Sea, Nord'el is bound for Auberdine after its recovery in the Wetlands. For night elves still grieving the loss of their immortality, the flower carries the grace of Elune.
attribution: In-game quest text: Bloom of the Heavens
